templates.name: crewShowcase
templates.label: Crew: big heading with a slider of crew cards

fields.name: members
fields.label: Crew members in the slider (file names, in order)
fields.description: Each one is the member's file name in Crew, e.g. "benji", "antoine", "sergio-torres-canei".

fields.name: photos
fields.label: Photos in the slider instead of crew cards (optional)
fields.description: When photos are added, the slider shows them and the crew cards are not shown.

fields.name: video
fields.label: Video (optional, MP4)
fields.description: Short, silent, a few MB. It plays in the slider in place of this photo; the photo shows while it loads.

fields.name: photoNote
fields.label: Text shown while there are no photos
fields.description: e.g. "[PENDIENTE]". Not shown once a photo is set.

templates.name: actions
templates.label: Two buttons (a main one and a "more info" one)

fields.name: primaryLabel
fields.label: Main button: words
fields.description: e.g. "Book now"

fields.name: secondaryLabel
fields.label: Second button: words
fields.description: e.g. "Contact us for more info"

fields.name: secondaryMessage
fields.label: Second button: message already written in the contact form
fields.description: The second button opens the contact form with this message.

templates.name: tripBoats
templates.label: The boats of the trip (big photos, specs and features)

fields.name: detailsLabel
fields.label: Button that opens the full boat details
fields.description: e.g. "See full details"

fields.name: boatItems
fields.label: Boats (one panel each, in this order)

fields.name: boat
fields.label: Boat (file name in Boats)
fields.description: e.g. "bay-dreamer" (the Lagoon 450F) or "beneteau-sense-55". Its photos, specs and features come from the Boats collection.

fields.name: tag
fields.label: Which departure it is for
fields.description: e.g. "Open Cabins · Nov 22 to 25"

fields.name: tripNote
fields.label: What applies on this trip (optional)
fields.description: e.g. "On this departure: 3 guest cabins · up to 6 guests"

fields.name: banner
fields.label: Big wide photo shown first (optional)
fields.description: A landscape photo across the full width. When set, the slider with all the photos and the information sit below it.

fields.name: displayName
fields.label: Name shown (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty to use the boat's own name.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Small line under the name (optional)
fields.description: e.g. "Catamaran"

fields.name: about
fields.label: Description for this trip (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty to use the boat's own description.

fields.name: specs
fields.label: Specs for this trip (optional)
fields.description: When filled, these replace the boat's own specs. Use them when the trip differs from the boat's data sheet.

fields.name: featureList
fields.label: Features for this trip (optional)
fields.description: When filled, these replace the boat's own features.

fields.name: similarNote
fields.label: Note under the specs (optional)
fields.description: e.g. "Or a similar boat with equal or greater characteristics."

templates.name: cinematicRoute
templates.label: Route with a map (full-screen photos that change as you scroll)

fields.name: places
fields.label: Places on the map
fields.description: Each place has a latitude and longitude. The route is drawn through the water between them.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Short code (no spaces)
fields.description: e.g. "lapaz". The steps below use it.

fields.name: sub
fields.label: Small line under the name
fields.description: e.g. "Start and finish"

fields.name: lon
fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: e.g. -110.3245 (negative)

fields.name: tab
fields.label: Tab name
fields.description: e.g. "Dive Day"

fields.name: beats
fields.label: Steps (one full-screen scene each, in order)

fields.name: label
fields.label: Small line above the title
fields.description: e.g. "Dive Day · November 23"

fields.name: night
fields.label: Night line (optional)
fields.description: e.g. "Night at anchor · south of Espíritu Santo"

fields.name: via
fields.label: Passes by (place codes, in order, optional)

fields.name: imageNote
fields.label: Text shown while there is no photo
fields.description: e.g. "[PENDIENTE]". Not shown once a photo is set.

fields.name: mapNote
fields.label: Note under the map
fields.description: e.g. "Proposed route and anchorages. Final plan depends on weather."

templates.name: faq
templates.label: Questions and answers (open and close)

templates.name: memberProfile
templates.label: Team member profile (text on the left, crew card on the right)

fields.name: member
fields.label: Crew member (file name)
fields.description: The member's file name in Crew, e.g. "monique", "sergio-torres-canei", "lou". Their photos, quote and tags show on the right; their "about" text follows your text on the left.

fields.name: collapseAbout
fields.label: Short version: show only the text above, and put everything else inside "Keep reading"
fields.description: Off: the member's own about text is shown, and "Keep reading" opens their history and reasons. On: only your short text is shown.

fields.name: moreText
fields.label: Extra text at the end of "Keep reading" (optional)
fields.description: Closed until the visitor opens "Keep reading", after the member's own history and reasons. Good for a short list.

templates.name: funnel
templates.label: Trip planning form (the "Build your expedition" form)

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note for editors (not shown on the page)
fields.description: This block shows the same form as the homepage. Its texts are edited once, under "Home / Customize funnel".

templates.name: eventIntro
templates.label: Event: about us (small label, centered text, closing line)

fields.name: closing
fields.label: Last line, slightly larger, on its own

templates.name: eventEvening
templates.label: Event: the evening (text on the left, photos on the right)

fields.name: note
fields.label: Smaller line in italics under them

fields.name: address
fields.label: Small address line under the text (optional)

fields.name: photos
fields.label: Photos on the right (the place, the dishes, the wine)
fields.description: Up to 3. The first one is shown larger.

templates.name: eventPhotoStrip
templates.label: Event: three photos side by side, with a title and text

templates.name: eventPeople
templates.label: Event: people slider (photo, first name, role; text and quote over the photo)

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text under the title (2 to 4 lines)

fields.name: moreLabel
fields.label: Small link beside that heading: words (optional)

fields.name: moreHref
fields.label: Small link beside that heading: address (optional)
fields.description: e.g. "/en/passionate-sea-people/"

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text shown over the photo (hover or tap)

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote shown over the photo (hover or tap)

templates.name: eventCards
templates.label: Event: two large image cards with a button

fields.name: href
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Anchor ("#customize"), internal path ("/en/boats") or full URL.

templates.name: eventRsvp
templates.label: Event: confirm your place (Tally form)

fields.name: anchor
fields.label: Section name used by the hero button
fields.description: Without the #. If the hero button links to "#confirm", write "confirm".

fields.name: tallyUrl
fields.label: Tally form link
fields.description: The share link of the form in Tally (tally.so/r/...). Answers go to the spreadsheet connected to that form. Nothing shows until a link is set.

fields.name: height
fields.label: Form height (px)
fields.description: Defaults to 1100. Make it taller if the form is cut off.

templates.name: eventPlace
templates.label: Event: the place (full-width photo, address and map link)

templates.name: moguProposal
templates.label: Trip proposal (Mogu embed)

fields.name: tripSlug
fields.label: Mogu trip slug
fields.description: Only the trip code from Mogu's link: the part after /trips/ and before any "?". In https://v2.app.moguplatform.com/trips/baja-sailing-7-days?embed=true the code is "baja-sailing-7-days". It becomes https://v2.app.moguplatform.com/trips/<code>?embed=true.

fields.name: hideLogo
fields.label: Hide Mogu's logo bar
fields.description: Adds &hideLogo=true to the embed.

fields.name: hideTitle
fields.label: Hide the trip title
fields.description: Adds &hideTitle=true to the embed.

fields.name: height
fields.label: Embed height (px)
fields.description: Defaults to 600 if left blank.

fields.name: iframeTitle
fields.label: Embed name (accessible label, not visible text)
fields.description: Read by screen readers to name the embedded proposal. Defaults to "Trip proposal" if left blank.

templates.name: moguHero
templates.label: Trip proposal, full screen (first block: header floats over it)

fields.name: tripSlug
fields.label: Mogu trip slug
fields.description: Only the trip code from Mogu's link: the part after /trips/ and before any "?". The frame fills the screen height.

fields.name: iframeTitle
fields.label: Embed name (accessible label, not visible text)
fields.description: Defaults to "Trip proposal" if left blank.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Search results & sharing (SEO)
fields.description: How this page appears in Google and when a link to it is shared. Optional — empty falls back to the page's own title and text.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Page title (browser tab and Google)
fields.description: Around 50–60 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description (Google)
fields.description: One or two sentences, up to about 155 characters.

fields.name: ogTitle
fields.label: Sharing title (optional)
fields.description: Used in share previews. Empty uses the page title.

fields.name: ogDescription
fields.label: Sharing description (optional)
fields.description: Used in share previews. Empty uses the description.

fields.name: base
fields.label: Home base
fields.description: e.g. "La Paz, Baja California Sur"

fields.name: whatsapp
fields.label: WhatsApp number
fields.description: Digits only with country code, no "+" or spaces, e.g. "525568090942".

fields.name: funnelIntro
fields.label: Funnel WhatsApp intro (fallback)
fields.description: Mirrors __BRAND__.funnelIntro. The per-language opening line lives in Home / Customize funnel > WhatsApp message template; this is the fallback.

fields.name: leadEndpoint
fields.label: Lead-capture endpoint (Formspree)
fields.description: Not part of __BRAND__: main.js hardcodes FORMSPREE_ENDPOINT and its own comment says the real form is still pending. Moved here so it is editable; confirm the real endpoint before launch.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Google account email
fields.description: Lowercase. Must be the exact address of the Google account they sign in with.
